categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the textile industry, focusing on two main segments: yarn production and fabric manufacturing. It engages in OEM/ODM product design, R&D, manufacturing, sales, and trading. The product range includes pure cotton yarn, rayon yarn, various functional blended yarns, core-spun yarn, woven and knitted fabrics, and functional textiles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile manufacturing processes including combed cotton yarn production, weaving, dyeing, printing, finishing, and garment manufacturing. It emphasizes the development of functional and differentiated yarns and fabrics, incorporating new materials such as Japanese functional fibers and environmentally friendly dyes. The company also integrates vertical supply chain operations from spinning to fabric design and dyeing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global well-known fashion and sports brands, mainly in Taiwan, Japan, Europe, the United States, China, and ASEAN countries. The company supplies semi-finished yarns and fabrics to these customers who then produce garments for global markets. The focus is on brand customers requiring high-quality, functional, and customized textile products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and Vietnam, with a manufacturing plant in Ba Ria-Vung Tau Province, Vietnam. Its sales markets cover Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America, with Southeast Asia and Vietnam being significant growth regions. The company also has investments and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Korea, and other locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, including spinning, weaving, dyeing, and fabric finishing. It also engages in some downstream activities such as garment manufacturing and wholesale/retail of textile products. The company is building vertical integration within its supply chain to enhance competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include optimizing product mix by focusing on special yarns and reducing cotton yarn proportion to improve gross margin. The company invests in R&D for functional and differentiated yarns and fabrics, environmentally friendly materials, and digital transformation in textile production. It aims to deepen supply chain vertical integration, expand brand customer base, and enhance marketing and sales capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of yarns and fabrics. The company also engages in OEM/ODM manufacturing and international trade of textile products. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on direct sales to brand customers and wholesale distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from textile manufacturers in China, India, and other Southeast Asian countries, especially in functional textiles. It differentiates itself through higher product quality, R&D capabilities, and vertical integration. The company is recognized as a key supplier to major global sports and fashion brands, positioning itself as a premium functional textile provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.63 billion, a 40.44% increase from the previous year. It returned to profitability with a net income attributable to the parent company of NT$112 million, reversing prior losses. The company has shown growth in fabric sales and is expanding production capacity, especially in Vietnam, to support international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, diversified, and innovative textile products with a focus on functional and environmentally friendly materials. It offers customized product development aligned with brand customer needs and maintains competitive advantages through vertical supply chain integration, rapid response, short lead times, and cost control. Its commitment to sustainability and ethical business practices further differentiates its offerings.
